summary: Treed west kerb on a quiet street; houses 20+ m back but cars park mostly opposite.
reasons: Bushy bank, little parking on this kerb

best_section.where: Ryans Road west kerb, below the wooded bank before the bend

drivers.seclusion: Treed bank screens the section; closest homes are 25 m (at 48 m) and 12 m (from 57 m), others set back behind gardens.
drivers.access_and_room: Road looks wide enough to stop at the kerb, but the west side is a tree-lined bank with little visible verge.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential road near a busier junction at the north end.
drivers.convention: Cars park opposite and on the northern part of this kerb; none seen on this exact stretch.

flags: Room beside the lane is tight where the bank meets the kerb
Houses 12 m from the end of the section
No signs mapped on this kerb
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade on the west side; sun comes over the road from the east.
